Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to utilize data from a user interface to enhance the alignment computation.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further configured to adaptively update the current step identification based on user interactions with the user interface.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is dynamically adjusted based on real-time user actions.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is responsive to user inputs.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and is further configured to predict the next step based on historical user actions.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on user engagement metrics.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is contingent upon user actions.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, further incorporating contextual data from user interactions.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images and user interaction data to calculate the alignment.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, including feedback from user interactions.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the extraction is informed by user interaction data.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the scrolling is responsive to user actions on the user interface.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images and user interaction data to calculate the alignment.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, incorporating user feedback into the alignment process.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step utilizes user interaction data to refine the alignment.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and adapting the identification based on user interactions.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is dynamically adjusted based on real-time user actions.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and predicting the next step based on historical user actions.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on user engagement metrics.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, further incorporating contextual data from user interactions.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, and further incorporates user interaction data.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, including feedback from user interactions.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extraction is informed by user interaction data.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, wherein the program incorporates user interaction data to enhance the alignment process.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, wherein the scrolling is responsive to user actions on the user interface.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, and further incorporates user interaction data.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, incorporating user feedback into the alignment process.

Claim 32 (Currently amended): A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, wherein the program incorporates user interaction data to enhance the guidance process.
